title: Tensor calculation for locally finitely presented ell-adic sheaves
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $X$ a scheme with noetherian underlying space, and $\Lambda$ an ell-adic finiteness coefficient ring: a continuous condensed finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, its continuous integral unit ball, or the finite-subextension condensed algebraic closure [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Put $R=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. If $F,G$ are locally finitely presented internal $R$-modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], then $F[0]\otimes_R^{\mathrm L}G[0]$ has no cohomology below degree $-1$, and its cohomology in every integer degree is locally finitely presented. No finite-type, separatedness, quasi-compactness or residue-characteristic hypothesis on $X$ is imposed.

proof.text: In both field cases, local finite presentation on the noetherian scheme implies local finite freeness. For a continuous finite extension, lift the coefficient field to ULift in the scheme universe, apply the field local-triviality theorem, and transport the free cover back by liftCoefficientIso and the coefficient comap equivalence. For the algebraic closure use the proved raw-pullback conversion algcl_lf. Apply the locally finite free tensor calculation and weaken the lower bound zero to minus one.

For integral coefficients choose the short exact resolution 0→F1→F0→F→0 with both Fi locally finite free. Apply tensorRight(single G) to its distinguished single-sheaf triangle, giving A→B→C→A[1] with C the desired tensor. A and B have lower bound zero by the finite free calculation. In the rotated triangle B→C→A[1], both outer terms have lower bound minus one, so t-structure extension closure gives that bound for C.

Let P be local finite presentation over the integral coefficient. Apply the proved integral_lfp_kernel_of_rational API, supplied with rationalMatrixKernels_of_integral, integralMatrixKernels_of_pivots and integralMatrix_pivot_cover, to get kernel closure. The proved generic lfp_cokernel and lfp_extension helpers give cokernel and extension closure. Zero and isomorphism invariance are immediate from the presentation APIs. Consequently DerivedCategory.homologyProperty P is triangulated; A and B satisfy it by the finite free calculation, so C does too. These are proved local helpers of the cited modules, not an additional finite-model assumption.

For the integral finite-intermediate-field constructor use the norm induced from the algebraic closure and its compatible normed algebra structure. For the general unit-ball constructor, its stated equality of sets identifies the coefficient subring with continuousIntegers. Both reduce to the integral calculation without changing coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem lfp_tensor_single
    {ℓ : ℕ} [h : IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
    (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hF : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X) F)
    (hG : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X) G) :
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ⊗
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G).IsGE (-1) ∧
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ⊗
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))
